results.overview: Nancy Drew makes plans to leave her hometown for college, but finds herself drawn into a supernatural murder mystery instead.
results.name: Nancy Drew

results.overview: John Doe tell the story of a man who wakes up naked on an island off the coast of Seattle, knowing everything in the world there is to know—except for who he is and how and why he ended up there.
results.name: John Doe

results.overview: 12-year-old Griffin Campbell and his family move to the small town of Sulphur Springs and take ownership of an abandoned hotel rumored to be haunted by the ghost of a girl who disappeared decades ago. Griffin befriends Harper, a bright-eyed, mystery-obsessed classmate and together, they uncover a secret portal that allows them to travel back in time. In the past, they’ll attempt to uncover the key to solving this unsolved mystery, a mystery that affects everyone close to them.
results.name: Secrets of Sulphur Springs

results.overview: Kolchak: The Night Stalker is an American television series that aired on ABC during the 1974–1975 season. It featured a fictional Chicago newspaper reporter who investigated mysterious crimes with unlikely causes, particularly those that law enforcement authorities would not follow up. These often involved the supernatural or even science fiction, including fantastic creatures.
results.name: Kolchak: The Night Stalker

results.overview: Set in the fictional college town of Hilltowne, Charmed follows the lives of three sisters, Macy, Mel and Maggie Vera who, after the tragic death of their mother, discover they are three of the most powerful witches of all time.
results.name: Charmed

results.overview:
استان در نیواورلئان اتفاق می‌افتد. «Briar» یک دختر نوجوان نیویورکی است که وارد یک مدرسهٔ اسرارآمیز جادوگری می‌شود و متوجه می‌شود که خودش یک جادوگر است.

او همراه دو دختر دیگر، Sasha و Tegan، یک کاون تشکیل می‌دهد؛ اما مدرسه فقط محل آموزش جادو نیست. درگیری میان جادوگران و خون‌آشام‌ها، جادوی تاریک، رازهای خانوادگی و روابط عاشقانه، زندگی آنها را پیچیده می‌کند.
results.name: آکادمی جادوگران

results.overview: We love to play games with our children. But what happens when someone else starts to play with them too? Someone we don't know. Can't see. Can't hear. In The Whispers, someone or something -- is manipulating the ones we love most to accomplish the unthinkable. An unseen alien force has figured this human weakness out. They have invaded earth and are using our most unlikely resource to achieve world domination – our children.
results.name: The Whispers

results.overview: Television networks battle one another in an unrelenting ratings war. Whoever controls the airwaves controls the dystopic world in which they broadcast. So when Network 23's star reporter, Edison Carter, uncovers a deadly secret that could shake up the station's dominion over its viewers, the only option is to eliminate Carter before he can make his story public. After Carter's "accident," his mind is uploaded to create the world's first self-aware, computer-generated TV host — Max Headroom! But will Max bow to his creators? Or will he be the key to his human alter ago bringing down a network superpower?
results.name: Max Headroom

results.overview: After fully recovering from her near fatal bout of bionic rejection, Jaime Sommers, the first female cyborg, is assigned to spy missions of her own.
results.name: The Bionic Woman

results.original_name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
results.overview: Each season of this horror anthology series follows a different group of kids, members of the Midnight Society, as they discover terrifying curses and creatures.
results.name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?

results.overview: The Time Tunnel is a 1966–1967 U.S. color science fiction TV series, written around a theme of time travel adventure. The show was creator-producer Irwin Allen's third science fiction television series, released by 20th Century Fox and broadcast on ABC. The show ran for one season of 30 episodes. Reruns are viewable on cable and by internet streaming. A pilot for a new series was produced in 2002, although it was not picked up.
results.name: The Time Tunnel

results.overview: Mick St. John is a captivating, charming and immortal private investigator from Los Angeles, who defies the traditional blood-sucking norms of his vampire tendencies by using his wit and powerful supernatural abilities to help the living.
results.name: Moonlight

results.original_name: Psi Factor: Chronicles of the Paranormal
results.overview: عامل ناشناخته (به انگلیسی: Psi Factor: Chronicles of the Paranormal) یک سریال ۸۸ قسمتی ساخت تورنتو کانادا است که موضوع علمی - تخیلی دارد، و بین ۱۹۹۶ تا ۲۰۰۰ پخش شد. دن ایکروید کارگردان این سریال از کودکی به داستان‌های علمی تخیلی علاقه داشت. ابتدا قرار نبود این مجموعه در ۴ فصل ساخته شود اما به دلیل استقبال از این سریال؛ ساخت این سریال ادامه یافت. صحبت های دن آکروید در آغاز و پایان هر قسمت از این مجموعه موجب شد تا گروهی از بینندگان فکر کنند که داستان های این مجموعه واقعیت دارد و آن را جدی بگیرند. در حالی که مجموعه فقط یک داستان اسکریپت است. بیشتر به همین دلیلی که ذکر شد کمیته تحقیقات ادعاهای فراطبیعی به دن آکروید جایزه شمع خاموش شده را داد. این کمیته دلیل این جایزه را «مشارکت در درک نادرست مردم از روشهای پژوهش علمی» عنوان کرد. داستان سریال در مورد یک تیم از محققان علمی متعلق به یک گروه علمی است که به بررسی گزارش از پدیده های ماوراء الطبیعه می پردازند...
results.name: عامل ناشناخته

results.overview: After resigning, a secret agent is abducted and taken to what looks like an idyllic village, but is really a bizarre Kafkaesque prison. His warders demand information. He gives them nothing, but only tries to escape.
results.name: The Prisoner

results.overview: Psi Factor: Chronicles of the Paranormal is a Canadian science fiction television series that surrounds a scientific team that deals with all manner of paranormal phenomena around the world; from alien abductions to possessions. The organization depicted in the series is loosely inspired by a real-life scientific organization. While locations in the series took place worldwide, the series was primarily filmed in and around Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and aired 88 episodes over four seasons from 1996 to 2000.

results.overview: When Frank and Joe Hardy arrive in Bridgeport, they set out to uncover the truth behind the recent tragedy that has changed their lives. In doing so, they stumble upon something much more sinister - something only the Hardy Boys can stop.
results.name: The Hardy Boys

results.overview: The adventures of Miss Jane Marple, an elderly spinster living in the quiet little village of St Mary Mead. During her many visits to friends and relatives in other villages, Miss Marple often stumbles upon mysterious murders which she helps solve. Although the police are sometimes reluctant to accept Miss Marple's help, her reputation and unparalleled powers of observation eventually win them over.
results.name: Agatha Christie's Marple

results.overview: A Silicon Valley pioneer discovers that one of his own creations – a powerful A.I. – might spell global catastrophe, and teams up with a cybercrime agent to fight a villain unlike anything we’ve ever seen – one whose greatest weapon against us is ourselves.
results.name: NEXT

results.overview: A small town is suddenly and inexplicably sealed off from the rest of the world by an enormous transparent dome. While military forces, the government and the media positioned outside of this surrounding barrier attempt to break it down, a small group of people inside attempt to figure out what the dome is, where it came from, and when (and if) it will go away.
results.name: Under the Dome

results.overview: A television anthology series hosted by Alfred Hitchcock featuring dramas, thrillers, and mysteries.
